latest.title: Understanding Amazon EC2: What Actually Happens When You Launch a Cloud Server?
latest.description: Clicking Launch on an EC2 instance triggers a chain of steps: image, hardware, network, storage, and boot. This guide walks through each one, with diagrams, so launching a cloud server stops feeling like magic.

latest.title: Improving AWS ECS Fargate Auto Scaling for PHP Applications During Sudden Traffic Spikes
latest.description: Our goal is to identify and address scaling bottlenecks by optimizing CloudWatch metrics, scaling policies, container startup time, PHP-FPM configuration, and health checks. We are also exploring request-based and scheduled scaling to ensure sufficient capacity is available during peak traffic periods, particularly when handling up to 5,000 concurrent users.

latest.title: Once Upon Agentic AI (Part 2): Develop your own MCP server and cast its tools from Strands Agents
latest.description: In Part 1, every power lived inside the agent's Python file. This time, the power lives in a separate MCP server. By the end, the server log shows what every die rolled before the model saw the number.

latest.title: Netbouncer
latest.description: Turns a rooted Android phone into a real kernel-mode Tailscale subnet router and exit node: a genuine tailscale0 TUN interface with in-kernel routing and NAT, not Tailscale's userspace-networking fallback, runs Pi-hole for DNS filtering. Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S10+ (Exynos, codename beyond2lte), running LineageOS, rooted with Magisk.

latest.title: AWS: Zero to Hero — Week 13: Why Cloud and AI Are Really the Same Story
latest.description: Week 13 of learning AWS from zero, with Claude as my research partner. Why cloud and AI are really one story: scarce, lumpy GPU compute, UltraClusters, custom Trainium chips, data gravity, and the honest counterpoints. Hands-on: why a new account can’t launch a GPU, napkin math that reproduces Llama 2 7B’s training cost, and an Athena pipeline showing Parquet scans far fewer bytes than CSV.

latest.title: AWS Cost Optimization: Build Smarter Cloud Solutions
latest.description: Discover practical ways to reduce AWS spending using cost monitoring, resource optimization, storage lifecycle policies, and budgeting tools.

latest.title: One Lab, Multiple Paths: AWS Cloud Quest’s Hidden Perk
latest.description: Midway through AWS Cloud Quest? Discover how completing a single foundational lab automatically unlocks progress across multiple career paths on Skill Builder.

latest.title: Tokenomics - Governing AI Coding Agents with CloudWatch Omni
latest.description: Learn how to send Claude Code and Codex telemetry to CloudWatch Omni through a local OpenTelemetry collector, giving teams a shared view of token usage, tools, skills, and model costs. A day of telemetry reveals how long sessions and tool context can drive coding agent spend and where governance can make a difference.

latest.title: Day 50: Halfway Point – Planning a Capstone: A Full-Stack Java App on AWS
latest.description: Day 50 of my 90-day AWS challenge, halfway through: the plan for a capstone project that combines the services from the first seven weeks into one full-stack Java application, with an architecture, a six-day build schedule, and cost guardrails.

latest.title: How to Protect Files Stored in AWS S3
latest.description: I’m learning how Amazon S3 stores data and the security features available to prevent unauthorized access, accidental deletion, and data exposure.

trending.title: LLMs are compressors. So I chatted with gzip
trending.description: I chatted with gzip, for real. It answers questions about me with zero learned weights, and it says "i don't know" when a question surprises it too much. To see how that is possible, we need to understand why compressing and predicting are the same job.

trending.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration and Multi-Tenant RAG with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
trending.description: An architecture walkthrough connecting an orchestrator, specialist agents, and Code Interpreter with a knowledge-base tool behind AgentCore Gateway, Cedar authorization, and tenant-scoped retrieval filters.

trending.title: What If Every Pull Request Came With a Preview?
trending.description: A practical look at how pull requests can automatically create isolated previews for designers and run initial automated checks for QA. The article explains how Lambda MicroVMs, lifecycle management, authentication, and a lightweight controller make this workflow possible.

trending.title: Kiro Workflows: hand off an issue, get back a reviewed PR on staging
trending.description: I wrote a Kiro Workflows recipe that takes a GitHub issue to a reviewed draft PR on staging. This post covers the YAML, a real 51-minute run with its cost and what the reviewers missed, and how to set it up, verify it and clean up.

trending.title: Why Architecture is the True Security Boundary
trending.description: Network and identity aren't complete security boundaries on their own. Architecture is the real one.

trending.title: Defense in Depth for AI Agents
trending.description: A hands-on demo of defense in depth for an AI agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Four stacked layers, 14 attacks, and measured results on what each layer stops, misses and costs.

trending.title: What I Saw at KubeCon NA 2026
trending.description: After two talks, one workshop, and a week of hallway conversations at KubeCon NA 2026, my takeaway is that boring wins. Here’s what I learned about SLOs, observability, security, and the people who run it all.

trending.title: Crew remoto
trending.description: Cómo montar un entorno remoto para Kiro Crew sobre una instancia EC2 egress-only, accesible solo por Systems Manager, desplegada con CloudFormation y GitHub Actions, y con una regla de apagado diario para no pagar de más.

trending.title: Por qué escalar tu app por CPU no alcanza
trending.description: Por qué el HPA mirando la CPU llega tarde en apps web que esperan a la base, por qué no baja de 1 réplica y qué son las métricas de negocio. Parte 1 de la serie de mi charla en el AWS Student Community Day.

trending.title: Testing Terraform with AWS Emulator
trending.description: An in-depth overview and testing examples on AWS Emulator and using it to test Terraform plan and apply jobs.
